title: Measured fingerprint (closed-object, gate-evaluator input)
description: Closed-object schema for a measured fingerprint consumed by the pillar4 G1-G6 gate scaffold. The closed-object discipline (`additionalProperties: false` at every level) enforces the fixture-only contract STRUCTURALLY, not via field-name blacklist: any artifact under `golden/synthetic_pillar4_pilot/` whose JSON content contains an unknown field (regardless of name) is rejected with `loop_a_alt4_unknown_field` naming the offending JSON path. The `data_provenance` field is fixed at `measured`; a fingerprint with `data_provenance != measured` cannot be admitted by this schema. Aggregate consumers MUST stratify by `data_provenance` per the gate-evaluator's three-level provenance discipline.

data_provenance.description: Provenance class. Frozen at `measured` for every record this schema admits; synthetic predictions live in predicted_fingerprint.schema.json.

claim_scope.description: Cross-die claim-scope label. Local single-die measurements use `measured_local`; methodology-transfer claims to other dies use `methodology_transfer_only` and require accompanying transfer-methodology citations. `deferred` denotes a record that names a die where measurement is not yet collected.

dual_run_manifest_ref.description: Repo-relative path to the dual_run_manifest.json that pairs the CUPTI and NVBit runs the measurement derived from.

phase_cycle_ledger_ref.description: Repo-relative path to the phase_cycle_ledger.json sidecar this measurement consumed.

kernel_feature_vector_ref.description: Repo-relative path to the per-kernel feature-vector sidecar.

phase_cycle_ledger_ref.description: Repo-relative path to the phase-cycle-ledger sidecar.

roofline_coordinate_ref.description: Repo-relative path to the roofline-coordinate sidecar.

theta_vector_ref.description: Repo-relative path to the theta-vector sidecar.

distributional_metric_ref.description: Repo-relative path to the distributional-metric sidecar (KL/Wasserstein/KS over per-kernel `|gap_ns|`).
